newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - WHITE, N.J..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
The Board of Education of the Township of White
(County of Warren)
New Jersey
School Bonds
Bank-Qualified
Callable
Book-Entry-Only Bonds

SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Board Secretary of The Board of Education of the Township of White, in the County of Warren, New Jersey at the Board's offices, at 565 County Route 519, Belvidere, New Jersey 07823 on Wednesday
AUGUST 27, 1997
until 11:00 a.m. for the purchase of the following Bonds of the School District due (subject to prior redemption) on August 15 in each of the years as follows:
Year Principal Amount Year Principal Amount

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Bonds are redeemable at the option of the Board in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The Board will furnish Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Wilentz, Goldman &Spitzer, P.A., Woodbridge, New Jersey. The Bonds will be dated August 15, 1997 and will bear interest from that date at the rate per annum specified by the successful bidder in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale, payable on August 15, 1998 and semiannually thereafter on the fifteenth day of February and August in each year until maturity or earlier redemption.
Each proposal submitted must specify:
a. a single rate of interest that the Bonds are to
bear, in a multiple of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1%;
b. the principal amount of Bonds the bidder will
accept, which shall be $4,600,000 or any lesser
amount that is a multiple of $1,000, the Bonds
accepted being the first to mature; and
c. the price the bidder will pay, which shall be not
less than $4,600,000 nor more than $4,601,000.
The Bonds will be sold to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest. As between such proposals specifying the

same rate of interest, the Bonds will be sold to the b who offers to accept the least amount of Bonds. If two or more such bidders offer to accept the same amount of Bonds, then the Bonds will be sold to such bidder offering to pay therefor the highest price. if two or more such bidders offer to pay the same price, then the Bonds will be sold to one of such bidders selected by lot from among all such bidders. The purchaser must also pay an amount equal to the interest on the Bonds accrued to the date of payment of the purchase price.
The right is reserved to reject all bids, and any bid not complying with the terms of this notice will be rejected. Each bidder is required to deposit a certified,

treasurer's or cashier's check payable to the order of THE BOARD OF EDUCATION OF THE TOWNSHIP OF WHITE, IN THE COUNTY OF WARREN in the amount of $92,000 drawn upon a bank or trust company, and such check must be enclosed with the proposal.
The full Notice of Sale, the Preliminary Official
Statement and the bid forms are available by contacting the Board Secretary at The Board of Education of the Township
of White, 565 County Route 519, Belvidere, New Jersey 07823, (908) 475-3201 or the Board's Bond Counsel, Lisa Gorab, Esq., Wilentz, Goldman &Spitzer, P.A., (908) 855-6459.
/s/ Joyce A. Gibbs
Board Secretary
DATED: August 13, 1997
(From The Bond Buyer)
